pr_body:
This PR comes with lots of changes. Not everything may work as intended. There's still work that needs to be done. New commits to this PR will come as the time goes by. Please leave your review here what changes could be made to the code. What is yet to do (...and bugs that I'm aware of): - ~~Implement `IFilesystemOperations.RestoreFromTrashAsync()`~~ - ~~Only one item is reverted/restored by undo/redo~~ - ~~Broken Delete Permanently chceckbox~~ - ~~Even when multiple files are selected (to be deleted), Delete Dialog pops up for every item~~ - ~~When item is copied to the same directory, undo deletes the original item~~ - ~~History operations don't work with external devices~~ - ~~Undo/Redo won't work with shortcuts~~ **¹** - ~~Undo.Recycle, Redo.Restore are currently not working~~ - ~~Moving an item to a directory that already contains item with the same name, moves the item and renames it, Undo will move the item with the altered name and then calling Redo would crash the app~~
¹ - Shortcuts files have issues that this PR does not resolve. The problem is considered as *completed*

This Pull Request implements undo, redo functionality
This PR is a Draft.
Closes #1975
pr_comments: @d2dyno1 We're planning to merge #2215 soon, so it's best to work from that branch until we merge it to master. It includes a significant overhaul of some of our core architecture for code quality purposes.
Ok! I will continue pushing commits here. When the #2215 is pushed, I'll update the PR. For now, I'll try to make it not use App.CurrentInstance as much as possible.

Hi @d2dyno1 great work! I've just opened a [PR](https://github.com/d2dyno1/Files/pull/1) on your repo to fix a couple of issue I found while testing this, let me know if you agree with them. Mostly is fixing the usage of `GetDeferral()` which must be called before any `async` method.
Ok, I've fixed the deferral usage

If you copy-paste an item to the same folder to create a copy and than do "ctrl+Z" the original file will get deleted instead of the copied one.

![ezgif com-gif-maker](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9673091/98450405-e5ace600-213c-11eb-8e10-42feaec72eae.gif)

Good catch! Gonna look into that tomorrow

I'm adding a couple of issues I noticed:
- Undoing an operation on shortcut files crashes the app (UnauthorizedAccessException in `ToStorageItem`)
Note: StorageFile.* functions do not work for shortcuts, usually to operate on shortcuts we call the fulltrust process
- Undoing an operation in an android phone connected by usb crashes the app
Note: on some external devices/network drives the StorageFile `Path` property is empty which causes issues for this PR
Note: it's ok *not* to be able to undo operations in such occasions but no crash should happen

Hi @d2dyno1, another large commit has just been merged -> #2269
The PR reworks the exception handling for file operations.
If you need help merging the latest changes let us know!

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
It's sometimes annoying when you copy file(s) to a folder that you didn't intend to. Same with moving/deleting items.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
ctrl+z, ctrl+y to undo/redo filesystem operations
